# My Virtual Classroom — repository instructions for Copilot

Read the root `AGENTS.md` for project constraints and the root `PEDAGOGY.md` and `DESIGN.md` for the teaching and visual standards. All portals (`/electronics/`, `/artificial-intelligence/`), conceptual lessons (`testing/artificial-intelligence/what-is-ai.html`), and 3D circuit studios (`testing/electronics/resistor.html`, `transistor.html`) strictly follow the **`field-studies.ai.studio` white Swiss-editorial visual system** (`IBM Plex Sans` + `IBM Plex Mono`, `#ffffff` background, `#0a0a0a` ink, `#e5533d` coral accent, `#2b56d6` cobalt blue, `rgba(10,10,10,0.14)` hairline borders, `41px` sticky header, `#tiny-dot-cursor`, and `🍎` favicon). For any new or revised lesson, follow `.agents/skills/create-virtual-lab/SKILL.md` and its references.

Default to a complete 45-minute lesson (with progressive explanations, clickable vocabulary, interactive simulation/experiment, 5 stories/Think Together checks, and notebook summary), keeping Electronics and AI as separate 19-study portals (`[1]`–`[19]`). When a study includes a narrated animated explainer film (`#filmDialog` + `▶ Explainer film`), integrate it cleanly into the unified lesson page (`what-is-ai.html`) rather than creating duplicate sibling catalog entries. Preserve repository paths, subject separation and the build (`npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`).
